summary.text: Breane Buckingham, also known as Bree, is the Democratic candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 30B, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a retired veteran who has served in the Army and on the Arco City Council.

paragraphs.text: Buckingham ran for the same District 30B seat in 2024 and lost the general election to Republican Ben Fuhriman, 82.0 percent to 18.0 percent.
In her 2024 survey responses, she named responsible economic development in rural eastern Idaho and water rights as key priorities.
